# Chapter 14: Epilogue

And if a reader has made it this far — if someone has followed Bob through these recollections and reflections — then that reader has already entered the story.

The future is unwritten.

But human beings possess the power, each in limited yet meaningful ways, to try to make that future a good one.

That is enough.
